doc.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Mongo Santamaria and early recording sessions
title: Walter Wanderley, Milton Nascimento and Moondog
summary: Brown lists sessions with Walter Wanderley, Milton Nascimento and Moondog. Laws remembers some under Creed Taylor and admits to having forgotten many.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: No, but it might be a different session, because of the chronology. Then you did some Luis Gasca session, and then a Nat Adderley, Calling Out Loud, and then Walter Wanderley.
Walter Wanderley. Yeah, I remember that. That was Creed Taylor. I remember doing it.
Then there’s an A&M recording with Milton Nascimento. It’s got everybody in there.
What about the Moondog date? Do you remember that?
Moondog used to play on the streets, in the subways and stuff. But I don’t remember doing a session with him.
Yeah, you’re listed in the reed section, piccolo and flute.
Okay. That’s possible. Like I said, I did a lot of sessions that I can’t even remember.
